title: Filter Replacement Required
shortDescription: HEPA or carbon filter is saturated.
fullDescription:
E1 on Samsung air purifiers indicates the HEPA or activated carbon filter has reached end of service life. Continuing to run reduces CADR and can damage the fan.

Replace the filter and reset the indicator.

fixSteps.title: Reset
fixSteps.instruction: Hold filter reset button for 3 seconds.

videoSearchQuery: Samsung air purifier E1 filter replace

title: Dust Sensor Error
fullDescription:
E2 indicates the PM2.5 dust sensor is dirty or faulty. The purifier cannot auto-adjust speed without valid readings.

Clean the sensor lens with a dry cotton swab.

fixSteps.title: Locate sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Find the dust sensor on the side panel.

fixSteps.title: Clean lens
fixSteps.instruction: Use dry cotton swab to clean optical lens.

videoSearchQuery: Samsung air purifier E2 dust sensor

title: Fan Motor Error
shortDescription: Fan not spinning at commanded speed.
fullDescription: E3 occurs when the BLDC fan reports incorrect RPM feedback. Check for obstructions, then motor wiring and controller.

fixSteps.title: Inspect fan
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug, open rear, check for obstructions.

whenToCallPro: If fan motor replacement is unfamiliar.
videoSearchQuery: Samsung air purifier E3 fan motor

title: Gas Sensor Error
fullDescription: Samsung models with gas detection flag E4 when the VOC sensor fails self-test. The purifier still filters but auto mode is limited.

title: Wi-Fi Connection Lost
fullDescription: WF means Wi-Fi disconnected. Purifier runs but SmartThings is offline. Restart router and re-pair.

fixSteps.title: Re-pair
fixSteps.instruction: Long-press Wi-Fi button, follow app steps.

title: High Particulate Alert
fullDescription: PM alert appears when particulates exceed threshold. Purifier auto-ramps to max speed. Persistent highs may indicate smoke, cooking fumes, or dust event.

faq.a: No - it means the purifier is doing its job.

title: Auto Mode Disabled
shortDescription: Auto mode cannot engage due to sensor fault.
fullDescription: Auto mode requires valid dust and gas sensors. If either is faulting (E2/E4), auto disables. Fix sensor issue first.

fixSteps.title: Resolve sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Address underlying E2 or E4 code.

title: Child Lock Active
fullDescription: CL indicates child lock is enabled. Hold the child lock button for 3 seconds to disable.

fixSteps.title: Disable lock
fixSteps.instruction: Hold child lock button for 3 seconds.

faq.a: Yes, from holding button too long.

title: Filter Door Open
fullDescription: DR appears when the filter access panel is open or not fully latched. Interlock prevents operation.

fixSteps.title: Close door
fixSteps.instruction: Press all corners until door clicks.

faq.q: Is interlock a magnet or switch?

title: Humidity Sensor Error
shortDescription: Humidity sensor reading out of range.
fullDescription: Models with combined purifier/humidifier functions use HU to signal a failed humidity sensor. Humidification stops until repaired.

fixSteps.title: Dry sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Power off and let dry overnight.

whenToCallPro: If sensor does not recover after drying.

faq.a: Refilling water tank with spills often wets the sensor.
